newsitem.title: USA: Ocean Optique ends pact to acquire firm.
newsitem.headline: Ocean Optique ends pact to acquire firm.

text.p: Ocean Optique Distributors Inc said Tuessday it had terminated its agreement in principle to acquire VSI International Inc because the parties were unable to agree on terms of a definitive agreement.

Neil Lands, Ocean's chairman and chief executive officer said while his company was unable to consummate the previously annnounced stock for stock acquisition, Ocean management will continue to seek other avenues and opportunites to maximize shareholer value.
Ocean imports and distributes eyeglass frames and sunglasses in the mid- and premium-priced categories.
